---
title: "Posterior Latent Parasite-Age Distributions"
output: github_document
---

These heatmaps show posterior latent parasite age distributions inferred by the hierarchical staging model under a fixed sequestration assumption. Parasite age is shown continuously across the 48-hour asexual cycle, with the corresponding microscopy stages labelled above the plots.

The latent distribution represents the inferred underlying parasite population before accounting for sequestration from the peripheral circulation. It therefore includes both parasites represented in peripheral blood microscopy and infected red blood cells inferred to be sequestered and consequently underrepresented or absent from the peripheral blood sample.

Each row represents one patient. Colour represents the mean parasite density within each 0.1 hour age interval. Within each study, patients are ordered from bottom to top by increasing mean parasite age (`mu_age`).

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(data.table)
library(rstan)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

options(scipen = 999)
```

```{r paths, include = FALSE}
MODEL_DIR <- "Staging/Complete case/outputs"
DATA_DIR <- "Data"
RDS_DIR <- file.path(MODEL_DIR, "RDS")
CSV_DIR <- file.path(MODEL_DIR, "CSV")

UNIMODAL_FIT_FILE <- file.path(RDS_DIR, "fit_hierarchical_unimodal.rds")
BIMODAL_FIT_FILE <- file.path(RDS_DIR, "fit_hierarchical_bimodal.rds")
CLASSIFICATION_FILE <- file.path(RDS_DIR, "hierarchical_bimodality_classification.rds")
HIERARCHICAL_FILE <- file.path(CSV_DIR, "dat_all_hierarchical.csv")
```

```{r definitions, include = FALSE}
# ---- Definitions ----
# Student-t degrees of freedom used by the staging model
DF_T <- 10

# Parasite-stage boundaries across the 48-hour cycle
aa <- c(0, 6, 16, 26, 30, 34, 38, 48)

stage_names <- c("Tiny rings", "Small rings", "Large rings", "Early trophozoites",
                 "Mid trophozoites", "Late trophozoites", "Schizonts")

# Use 250 posterior draws to reconstruct each patient's age distribution
N_POSTERIOR_DRAWS <- 250L

# Evaluate parasite density in 0.1-hour bins across the 48-hour cycle
AGE_STEP <- 0.1
age_grid <- seq(0, 48 - AGE_STEP, by = AGE_STEP)
N_AGE <- length(age_grid)
```

```{r cohort, include = FALSE}
# ---- Cohort ----
dat_all <- fread(file.path(DATA_DIR, "dat_all.csv"))

# Reconstruct the same complete-case cohort used by the hierarchical models
required_columns <- c("ID", "age", "coma", "aconvulsions", "hb", "hct", "aanaemia",
                      "ashockcomp", "temp", "ahypoglyc", "outcome", "site", "Trial", "be",
                      "bun", "parasitaemia", "tring", "sring", "lring", "etroph", "mtroph",
                      "ltroph", "schizont")

dat_all <- dat_all[, ..required_columns]
dat_all <- dat_all[complete.cases(dat_all)]
dat_all[, total_stage := tring + sring + lring + etroph + mtroph + ltroph + schizont]

# Retain patients whose observed stage percentages sum to approximately 100%
dat_all <- dat_all[total_stage >= 93 & total_stage <= 107]
dat_all[, total_stage := NULL]
```

```{r patient-partition, include = FALSE}
# ---- Model classification ----
classification <- readRDS(CLASSIFICATION_FILE)

# Reconstruct the fixed unimodal and robust-bimodal patient partition
robust_bimodal <- classification[as.character(classification$category) == "Robust bimodal",
                                 , drop = FALSE]

# Preserve the patient ordering used in the fitted Stan models
robust_bimodal <- robust_bimodal[order(robust_bimodal$patient), , drop = FALSE]
bimodal_rows <- robust_bimodal$patient
unimodal_rows <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(dat_all)), bimodal_rows)

bimodal_ids <- as.character(dat_all$ID[bimodal_rows])
unimodal_ids <- as.character(dat_all$ID[unimodal_rows])

N_BIMODAL <- length(bimodal_ids)
N_UNIMODAL <- length(unimodal_ids)
```

```{r helpers, include = FALSE}
# ---- Density functions ----
# Select evenly spaced posterior draws
select_draws <- function(n, target) {
  if (target >= n) {
    return(seq_len(n))
  }
  unique(as.integer(round(seq(1, n, length.out = target))))
}

# Calculate wrapped Student-t density across the 48-hour parasite cycle
wrapped_t_density <- function(age, mu, sigma) {
  density <- numeric(length(age))

  for (m in -1:1) {
    density <- density + dt((age + m*48 - mu) / sigma, df = DF_T) / sigma
  }
  density
}

# Normalise each patient's age density to 100%
normalise_grid <- function(x) {
  total <- sum(x)
  100 * x / total
}
```

```{r unimodal, include = FALSE}
# ---- Unimodal posterior reconstruction ----
fit_unimodal <- readRDS(UNIMODAL_FIT_FILE)
post_u <- rstan::extract(fit_unimodal, pars = c("mu_age", "sigma_age"))
draw_u <- select_draws(nrow(post_u$mu_age), N_POSTERIOR_DRAWS)
latent_u <- matrix(0, nrow = N_UNIMODAL, ncol = N_AGE)

for (d in draw_u) {
  for (i in seq_len(N_UNIMODAL)) {

    latent_u[i, ] <- latent_u[i, ] + wrapped_t_density(age = age_grid,
                                                       mu = post_u$mu_age[d, i],
                                                       sigma = post_u$sigma_age[d, i])
  }
}

# Average the wrapped parasite-age density across posterior draws
latent_u <- latent_u / length(draw_u)

# Normalise the posterior-mean latent density for each patient
latent_u <- t(apply(latent_u, 1, normalise_grid))

rm(fit_unimodal, post_u)
gc()
```

```{r bimodal, include = FALSE}
# ---- Bimodal posterior reconstruction ----
fit_bimodal <- readRDS(BIMODAL_FIT_FILE)

post_b <- rstan::extract(fit_bimodal,
                         pars = c("mu_age_1_mod48", "mu_age_2_mod48", "sigma_age_1",
                                  "sigma_age_2", "weight1"))

draw_b <- select_draws(nrow(post_b$mu_age_1_mod48), N_POSTERIOR_DRAWS)
latent_b <- matrix(0, nrow = N_BIMODAL, ncol = N_AGE)

# Reconstruct both parasite-age components for each posterior draw
for (d in draw_b) {
  for (i in seq_len(N_BIMODAL)) {

    p1 <- wrapped_t_density(age = age_grid, mu = post_b$mu_age_1_mod48[d, i],
                            sigma = post_b$sigma_age_1[d, i])

    p2 <- wrapped_t_density(age = age_grid, mu = post_b$mu_age_2_mod48[d, i],
                            sigma = post_b$sigma_age_2[d, i])

    # Combine components using the posterior mixture weight
    w1 <- post_b$weight1[d, i]
    latent_b[i, ] <- latent_b[i, ] + w1*p1 + (1 - w1)*p2
  }
}

# Average and normalise the latent density for each patient
latent_b <- latent_b / length(draw_b)
latent_b <- t(apply(latent_b, 1, normalise_grid))

rm(fit_bimodal, post_b)
gc()
```

```{r combine, include = FALSE}
# ---- Combine latent distribution ----
# Return unimodal and bimodal patients to the original 3509-patient cohort
latent_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = 3509, ncol = N_AGE)
latent_matrix[unimodal_rows,] <- latent_u
latent_matrix[bimodal_rows,] <- latent_b
```

```{r row-order, include = FALSE}
# ---- Order patients within each trial by overall circular mu_age ----
hierarchical <- fread(HIERARCHICAL_FILE)

patient_order_table <- hierarchical[, .(ID = as.character(ID), Trial = as.character(Trial),
                                        mu_age)]

# Order rows by the posterior-derived overall circular parasite-age centre.
# For bimodal patients, mu_age is the overall circular mixture centre.
setorder(patient_order_table, Trial, mu_age, ID)

# Row ordering affects presentation only; parasite age remains on the x-axis
patient_order_table[, patient_order := seq_len(.N), by = Trial]
```

```{r long-format, include = FALSE}
# ---- Plot data ----
# Convert latent matrix to long format
make_long_matrix <- function(mat, distribution_name) {

  out <- data.table(patient_index = rep(seq_len(nrow(mat)), each = N_AGE),
                    parasite_age = rep(age_grid, times = nrow(mat)),
                    percentage = as.vector(t(mat)))

  out[, ID := as.character(dat_all$ID[patient_index])]
  out[, Trial := as.character(dat_all$Trial[patient_index])]
  out[, distribution := distribution_name]

  out <- merge(out, patient_order_table[, .(ID, Trial, patient_order)],
               by = c("ID", "Trial"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  out
}

# Plot latent density
plot_long <- make_long_matrix(latent_matrix, "Latent")
```

```{r colour-limits, include = FALSE}
# Use the same colour scale for both trials
FILL_MAX <- as.numeric(quantile(plot_long$percentage, probs = 0.995, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r plot-function, include = FALSE}
# ---- Heatmap ----
make_age_heatmap <- function(dat, trial_name, high_colour) {
  d <- dat[Trial == trial_name]

  ggplot(d, aes(x = parasite_age, y = patient_order, fill = percentage)) + geom_raster() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(6, 16, 26, 30, 34, 38), linewidth = 0.2, linetype = "dashed") +

    # Mark the seven parasite-stage intervals along the 48-hour age axis
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 48), breaks = c(0, 6, 16, 26, 30, 34, 38, 48),
                       expand = c(0, 0),
                       sec.axis = dup_axis(breaks = c(3, 11, 21, 28, 32, 36, 43),
                                           labels = c("Tiny rings", "Small rings",
                                                      "Large rings", "Early troph.",
                                                      "Mid troph.", "Late troph.",
                                                      "Schizonts"), name = NULL)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = high_colour, limits = c(0, FILL_MAX),
                        oob = scales::squish, name = "Parasite density\n(% per 0.1 h)") +
    labs(x = "Parasite age (h)", y = "Patients (increasing mu_age)",
         title = paste0(trial_name, ": posterior latent parasite-age distributions")) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "right")
}
```

```{r aquamat, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 7}
make_age_heatmap(plot_long, trial_name = "AQUAMAT", high_colour = "#E31B23")
```

```{r seaquamat, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 7}
make_age_heatmap(plot_long, trial_name = "SEAQUAMAT", high_colour = "#0066CC")
```
